description: Command-line diagnostics for Spring Boot and Quarkus applications
notes: Requires JDK 17 or later through JAVA_HOME or on PATH.
pre_install: Set-Content -Encoding ASCII -Path "$dir\bootui.cmd" -Value @('@echo off', 'setlocal', 'if defined JAVA_HOME if exist "%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe" goto java_home', 'where java.exe >nul 2>nul || goto no_java', 'java.exe -jar "%~dp0bootui-cli.jar" %*', 'exit /b %errorlevel%', ':java_home', '"%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe" -jar "%~dp0bootui-cli.jar" %*', 'exit /b %errorlevel%', ':no_java', 'echo ERROR: JDK 17 or later not found. Set JAVA_HOME or add java.exe to PATH. 1>&2', 'exit /b 1')
